filter_description: every pull request in the AIDev release's pull_request.parquet, before any study restriction

keep pull requests carrying at least one review event written by one of the six mapped agent accounts, timestamped between the PR opening and its close, and no later than the 2026-04-15 observation cutoff
keep pull requests where at least one of those agent review events was written by a product different from the PR's authoring product
keep pull requests whose FIRST cross-product agent review event leaves a complete 7-day response window before the observation cutoff, i.e. trigger no later than 2026-04-08

stage: Inline-trigger cohort (in scope for the addressed edge)
filter_description: keep pull requests whose first cross-product review arrived as an inline review comment; review summaries and PR-level comments carry no reply target, so no addressed edge can ever be built for them

parent_stage: Inline-trigger cohort (in scope for the addressed edge)
filter_description: keep pull requests whose trigger leaves a complete 30-day outcome horizon before the observation cutoff, i.e. trigger no later than 2026-03-16; the remainder cannot be followed for the full window
keep pull requests still open 48 hours after the trigger; the removed ones had already closed before the outcome window opened

parent_stage: Inline-trigger cohort (in scope for the addressed edge)
filter_description: keep pull requests whose earliest agent review trigger of EITHER relation is the cross-product one; a pull request that a same-product reviewer had already commented on earlier is relabelled same-product when the two trigger tables are merged and one row per PR is kept
note: no 30-day outcome horizon is applied on this branch, so it is a sibling of the merge-curve cohort, not its parent or child

stage: Exposed pull requests (exact addressed edge by hour 48)
filter_description: keep pull requests carrying at least one later inline comment whose stored reply target is the trigger comment's own identifier, posted within 48 hours of the trigger

parent_stage: Exposed pull requests (exact addressed edge by hour 48)
filter_description: switch of unit: the 109 exposed pull requests carry 128 exact reply events between them, because a pull request can receive more than one
note: unit change, not a filter; 128 events on 109 PRs

filter_description: keep reply events written by ordinary user accounts; the removed ones come from the triggering product itself, other bots, and mapped products other than the trigger's author
note: these 105 events fall on 97 pull requests

filter_description: keep reply events the pre-specified rule set classifies as a substantive response, dropping platform text, routing hand-offs to another automation, and bare acknowledgements
note: these 59 events fall on 56 pull requests
